name: Soft Launch
source:
Play as a new developer joining a small, slightly chaotic team at a game studio. Get to know your coworkers, settle into the job, and see where things might go.

[From [url=https://bunnychloe.itch.io/soft-launch-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名新开发者，加入游戏工作室的一个小而稍微混乱的团队。了解你的同事，适应工作，看看事情会怎样发展。

[来自[url=https://bunnychloe.itch.io/soft-launch-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
